new.content: Skip to content Home > Cyber Security Salary in Pune: Entry-Level to Senior Roles Cyber Security Salary in Pune: Entry-Level to Senior Roles Curious about Cyber Security salary in Pune? Explore salary trends from entry-level to senior positions, understand the skills that influence pay, and discover how the right Cyber Security training and certifications can help you secure high-paying roles in one of India's fastest-growing IT domains. Table of Contents PriyankaS3ri June 30, 2026 12:39 pm Pune has quietly become one of India’s strongest cyber security job markets, home to IT parks, BFSI offices, defence and automotive units, all hungry for skilled security talent. If you are weighing a Cyber Security Course in Pune or simply curious what the field pays, the numbers vary widely by role, experience, and certification. This guide breaks down cyber security salary in Pune from fresher packages to senior leadership pay, with real city comparisons and the skills that move your number up. Entry-Level Cyber Security Salary in Pune: What Freshers Can Expect Entry-level cyber security professionals are in high demand as organizations seek skilled talent to manage growing security risks. Freshers who complete industry-relevant training through Cyber Security Classes in Pune often find opportunities in security operations, vulnerability assessment, and network security. Entry-Level Cyber Security Positions Job Role Average Salary (Per Year) Security Analyst ₹3.5 LPA – ₹6 LPA SOC Analyst ₹4 LPA – ₹6.5 LPA Information Security Associate ₹4 LPA – ₹7 LPA Network Security Engineer ₹4.5 LPA – ₹7 LPA Vulnerability Assessment Analyst ₹5 LPA – ₹8 LPA The average cyber security fresher salary in Pune typically ranges between ₹3.5 LPA and ₹6 LPA, depending on skills, certifications, and employer requirements.since most candidates entering the field through a Cyber Security Course in Pune with Placement land their first role in this band. Certifications genuinely move the needle here. A graduate with hands-on lab experience in tools like Wireshark, Nessus, or basic SIEM platforms typically negotiates a better offer than someone with a degree alone. Download Free e-Guide Cyber Security Salaries in Pune for Senior Professional Roles The real growth story in Pune’s cyber security salary in Pune trajectory unfolds after the 3 to 5 year mark. Once professionals build domain depth, whether in cloud security, penetration testing, or governance, pay climbs steeply, often outpacing salary growth in general IT roles. The average cyber security salary in Pune for experienced professionals ranges from ₹12 LPA to over ₹35 LPA depending on expertise and leadership responsibilities. Experienced-Level Cyber Security Positions Senior Role Average Salary (Per Year) Cyber Security Engineer ₹10 LPA – ₹18 LPA Security Consultant ₹12 LPA – ₹22 LPA Penetration Tester ₹10 LPA – ₹20 LPA Security Architect ₹18 LPA – ₹35 LPA Cyber Security Manager ₹20 LPA – ₹40 LPA+ CISO, or chief information security officer ₹35 LPA – ₹1 Crore+ Professionals working in large enterprises or global organizations often receive additional benefits such as: Performance bonuses Stock options Health benefits Remote work flexibility Professional certification sponsorships Many leading cyber security companies in Pune actively seek experienced professionals who possess expertise in cloud security, threat intelligence, penetration testing, and governance frameworks. Advanced cyber security positions continue to fetch high wages across industries as businesses rely more on digital infrastructure. Cyber Security Pay Scales Across India’s Top Cities Location remains one of the strongest predictors of pay in this field. While Pune holds its own, metros like Bangalore consistently lead the national pay scale because of their concentration of global security vendors and product companies. City Avg. Understanding these helps you plan a realistic career path rather than chasing numbers blindly. Experience level: Pay typically grows five to eight times from fresher to senior specialist, a jump steeper than most other IT functions. Certifications: CEH, CompTIA Security+, CISSP, and OSCP can each add 15% to 40% over non-certified peers. Industry sector: BFSI and defence pay a premium for compliance-heavy roles, while education and government roles trend lower but offer stability. Company size and type: Product companies and MNCs generally pay more than service-based firms for the same designation. Specialization: Cloud security, penetration testing, and security architecture consistently out-earn generalist analyst roles. Location within the city: IT corridors like Hinjewadi and Kharadi tend to host higher-paying employers than peripheral areas. Email Phone Send Top Cyber Security Skills That Offer High Salaries in India When negotiating a pay, not every talent is given equal weight. Some specialisations are growing faster than others because of how quickly threats and compliance demands are evolving. Cloud security (AWS, Azure, GCP): The fastest-growing specialisation, with certified professionals earning a clear premium over generalists. Penetration testing and ethical hacking: Offensive security skills remain scarce, pushing entry and mid-level pay above SOC analyst roles. SIEM and threat detection tools (Splunk, QRadar, Microsoft Sentinel): Core to SOC and analyst roles, and a strong differentiator on a resume. Governance, risk, and compliance (GRC): Demand has risen sharply following India’s data protection regulations. Security architecture and zero-trust design: High-responsibility, high-paying roles reserved for experienced professionals. AI and LLM security: An emerging niche commanding a meaningful pay premium over standard security roles. Professionals who master these skills often secure some of the highest-paying cyber security jobs salary packages in India. Combining technical expertise with certifications and practical experience can accelerate career growth significantly. It’s also worth researching established cyber security companies in Pune hiring for these specialisations, since the employer often matters as much as the skill set itself. Conclusion In India, cyber security is still one of the most lucrative and rapidly expanding technology fields. Pune’s increasing IT industry, rising need for security specialists, and first-rate training options have made it a popular choice for prospective professionals. Entry-level professionals can begin with competitive salaries and steadily progress into specialized and leadership positions with experience and certifications. Whether you are a student, graduate, or working professional, investing in the right skills and training can open doors to rewarding cyber security careers and long-term professional success.
